TDG_2009_p98__title_2.ocr: Options Not Pursuant to a Shareholder Approved Plan

TDG_2009_p98__paragraph_4.ocr:
In addition to the stock options issued under the 2003 stock option plan and 2006 stock incentive plan, two
members of the Company’s Board of Directors were also been granted stock options of TD Group. Of the
134,040 options issued under these agreements, 108,096 remain outstanding with an exercise price of $6.68. All
of such options were vested as of September 30, 2009.
